scope: Native proposal creation, editing through real native views, immutable commit/value read and current-card reads through each view. Uses the exact Plate facade and the frozen proposed text, review counts, cohort sizes and timing bounds. All samples and passes retained.
limitations: Native headless views are included. DOM event-to-paint, trusted input, clipboard and composition are separate required gates.
Overlap has 1000 actual sequential native proposals replacing the first character; legacy fixture has 1000 insertion labels on the same leaf. Ownership semantics differ; no overlap ratio claim.
Unrelated record visits, heap, retention and collaboration transport remain unmeasured.
Individual and bulk decision cohorts are separate required gates.
